project_description: A student dashboard, courses, assignments and calendar planner app built using React, Vite, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS.

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.purpose: Show student statistics, courses, upcoming deadlines, calendar events, and study metrics.

pages.name: Courses
pages.purpose: Show list of courses, and allow users to create, edit, and delete courses.

pages.name: Course Details
pages.purpose: Show detailed view of a course with its syllabus and assignments.

pages.name: Assignments
pages.purpose: List assignments, filter by status, and allow marking assignments as complete or creating new assignments.

pages.name: Calendar
pages.purpose: Show calendar events, and allow creating new calendar events.

flow.name: Create Course
steps: User enters course name, code, and instructor

flow.name: Edit Course
steps: User modifies course info and saves

flow.name: Create Assignment
steps: User enters assignment details and association with course

flow.name: Create Event
steps: User enters event details and saves

requirements.description: Modern dark-themed responsive dashboard for StudyHub
Shared entities must use local storage as single source of truth
No mock data arrays on the Dashboard; all statistics computed dynamically
